opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: Awards will only exceptionally exceed £6,000 and will generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000. Travel awards up to £2,000/£2,500 per person; PhD fieldwork visits up to £5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though the UK office may consider individuals with proof of organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring people in the UK and Japan together to deepen mutual understanding, encourage exchange of ideas or expertise, or develop lasting collaboration between the two nations.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: Up to £10,000; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally be able to show an existing research record, but consideration will also be given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields who intend to establish working links between organisations or produce a publishable comparative study. Preference to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration and early-career applicants.
opportunities.summary: Support exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare.
